data.title: Creative Producer (m/w/d)

data.company_name: SUXXEED Sales for your Success GmbH
data.description:
#Gemeinsam: Wir machen B2B-Vertrieb aus Leidenschaft. Über 350 Mitarbeitende unterstützen Geschäftskund:innen bei dem Vertrieb ihrer Produkte und Lösungen.
#Erfolgreich: Wir gestalten den Vertrieb der Zukunft und stoßen Innovationen an. Dabei arbeiten wir agil in starken, dynamischen Teams.
#Zukunftsorientiert: Wir wachsen immer weiter. Deshalb suchen wir dich. Wir bieten dir einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz mit Perspektive. Werde jetzt Teil der SUXXEED-Community!

Aufgaben

Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • Aufbau von KI Business-Cases begleiten: Du unterstützt unsere AI Business Case Analysts dabei, wirtschaftlich relevante KI-Anwendungsfälle zu identifizieren, zu analysieren und zu belastbaren Business Cases auszuarbeiten.
  • Geschäftsprozesse analysieren und verbessern: Du analysierst Prozesse in Vertrieb, Customer Operations und internen Unternehmensbereichen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Teams Ideen zur Automatisierung und Optimierung.
  • KI-Potenziale bewerten und priorisieren: Du hilfst dabei, den wirtschaftlichen Nutzen von KI-Lösungen messbar zu machen und bei der Priorisierung neuer Projekte fundierte Entscheidungsvorlagen zu erstellen.
  • Management-Reports und KPIs entwickeln: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Präsentationen, Business Cases, KPI-Modellen und Management-Unterlagen für laufende und geplante KI-Initiativen.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit AI Engineers und Fachbereichen: Als Teil eines neu aufgebauten AI Center of Excellence arbeitest du direkt mit Fachbereichen, AI Engineers und Führungskräften zusammen und erhältst einen umfassenden Einblick in die Entwicklung und Umsetzung moderner KI-Lösungen.

Qualifikation

Mit diesem Profil überzeugst du:

  • Du befindest dich aktuell in einem Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Business Analytics, Digital Business oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs mit Schwerpunkt AI.
  • Du begeisterst dich für die wirtschaftlichen Einsatzmöglichkeiten von KI und möchtest lernen, wie daraus belastbare Business Cases entstehen. Optimalerweise hast du bereits an der Erstellung von Business Cases mitgewirkt.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und hast Freude daran, Zusammenhänge zu analysieren, Daten auszuwerten und Lösungen strukturiert aufzubereiten. Zudem verfügst du idealerweise über erste Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse, Business Intelligence, Controlling, Prozessmanagement oder KPI-Steuerung.
  • Du möchtest praktische Erfahrungen in einem innovativen Umfeld sammeln und kannst regelmäßig an unserem Standort in Nürnberg arbeiten.
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit auf Deutsch (mind. C1-Niveau): Komplexe Zusammenhänge kannst du verständlich darstellen.

Benefits

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Du wirst Teil eines zukunftsweisenden Bereichs mit hoher strategischer Bedeutung für unser Unternehmen, arbeitest an realen KI-Projekten mit messbarem Business Impact und übernimmst früh eigene Verantwortung.
  • Für deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung: ein professionelles Onboarding & persönliches Mentoring durch erfahrene Kolleg:innen aus den Bereichen AI, IT und Business Development.
  • Langfristige Perspektive mit der Möglichkeit, nach deinem erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Studium in eine Festanstellung übernommen zu werden.
  • Eine faire Vergütung von 1.000€ pro Monat bei einer fest planbaren Anwesenheit von 2 Tagen pro Woche. Bei einem privaten Studium, beispielsweise an der FOM oder IU, können wir dir zusätzlich einen Zuschuss zu den Studiengebühren von bis zu 400 Euro monatlich gewähren.
  • Zusätzliche Rabatte über die Vodafone-Mitarbeitertarife und Benefit-Partnerportale sowie jährliche steuerfreie Bezuschussung auf deine Benefit Card bis zu 150€.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Dein SUXXEED-Recruiting Team

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

Du arbeitest hands-on mit Python, SQL und Databricks, mit End-to-End-Ownership vom Prototyp bis zum Betrieb – und nutzt KI-gestützte Entwicklung (z. B. Claude Code) als selbstverständliches Werkzeug, nicht als Extra-Thema.

  • Datenplattform verantworten: Du entwickelst unser Databricks Lakehouse weiter – Architektur, Pipelines, Betrieb, Kosten – und entscheidest, was wir wie ausbauen.
  • Datenmodell bauen: Du gestaltest das zentrale Datenmodell für Produkte, Kunden, Markt und Transaktionen – die Grundlage für Reporting, Self-Service und AI. Du entscheidest, wie viel Struktur wir brauchen und wo Pragmatismus gewinnt.
  • Systeme integrieren: Du bindest ERP (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central), CRM, externe Marktdaten und APIs an – robust, dokumentiert, überwacht.
  • AI in den Einsatz bringen: Du baust LLM-basierte Workflows, Agents und interne Tools, die auf der Plattform aufsetzen und Fachbereichen echte Arbeit abnehmen.
  • Engineering-Effizienz: Du automatisierst, was Engineering langsam macht – Deployments, Tests, Monitoring, Infrastruktur als Code – damit Änderungen an der Plattform in Minuten statt Tagen in Produktion gehen und Pipelines auch ohne Aufsicht verlässlich laufen.
  • Technisch führen: Du setzt die Leitplanken für Code-Qualität, Git-Workflow und Dokumentation, reviewst, was auf der Plattform landet, bist Sparringspartner für Analysten und Product Owner und technisches Gegenüber für externe Entwickler und Partner.
  • Mit dem Business arbeiten: Gemeinsam mit unserem Product Owner, unseren Analysten und den Fachbereichen übersetzt du Anforderungen in lauffähige Lösungen – vom Prototyp in Tagen bis zum stabilen Betrieb.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Builder im Data-/Tech-Umfeld – als Senior Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, Tech Lead oder Allrounder. Ob du den Titel Tech Lead schon trägst oder ihn dir hier holst, ist uns egal – Skill zählt mehr als Berufsjahre.

  • Databricks: Du hast produktiv auf Databricks oder einem vergleichbaren Lakehouse-Stack (Spark, Delta Lake) gebaut und weißt, wie man eine Plattform betreibt, nicht nur bespielt.
  • Datenmodellierung: Du hast Datenmodelle entworfen, die im Betrieb bestanden haben – dimensionale Modellierung, Stammdaten, Hierarchien – und kannst erklären, warum du dich wofür entschieden hast.
  • Python & SQL: Sehr gute Kenntnisse für Datenverarbeitung, Integrationen und Automation.
  • Erfahrung mit Integrationen und APIs: du verbindest Systeme, die nicht füreinander gemacht wurden. ERP-Erfahrung ist ein Plus.
  • Souveräner Umgang mit Git, CI/CD und sauberem Code – und die Fähigkeit, Standards in einem Team zu setzen, ohne Bürokratie zu erzeugen.
  • AI-Praxis: Du arbeitest mit LLM-APIs und KI-gestützten Entwicklungstools im Alltag und hast idealerweise schon Workflows oder Agents produktiv gebracht.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Builder-Mindset: Du lieferst Prototypen in Tagen statt Wochen, denkst in Outcomes und bringst Dinge in den Betrieb.

Nice-to-Have's

  • Erfahrung aus einem Scale-up, Mittelstand oder kleinen Team – du bist es gewohnt, breit zu arbeiten und Ownership zu übernehmen.
  • Azure-Grundlagen (Storage, Identity, DevOps) sind hilfreich.

Benefits

Das erwartet dich

  • Impact & Ownership: Du triffst die technischen Entscheidungen für die Plattform, setzt sie im Team mit einem Junior-Engineer um und hast direkten Draht zu Gründern und Management.
  • Eine Plattform, die steht – und Raum, sie zu prägen: Du startest nicht auf der leeren Leinwand, sondern auf einem produktiven Lakehouse. Wie es weitergeht, entscheidest du mit.
  • Moderner Stack, moderne Arbeitsweise: Databricks, Python, KI-gestützte Entwicklung – kein Legacy, kein „Das haben wir schon immer so gemacht“.
  • Speed & Verantwortung: Klarer Fokus auf Outcomes und schnelle Entscheidungen statt Hierarchie.
  • Purpose: Du erlebst die Entwicklung eines Pioniermarkts – und treibst diese mit voran.
  • Team-Spirit: Ein ambitioniertes Team mit pragmatischer und positiver Hands-on-Kultur.
  • Kantinenzuschuss: Moderner Office Komplex in Köln inkl. Kantine, die von uns bezuschusst wird (Warme Gerichte, Salatbar, Bowls of the Day uvm.)
  • Hrmony: Benefit Portal, in dem du dir monatlich individuell Gutscheine aussuchen kannst (z.B. Urban Sports, DB, Ikea oder REWE)

Bereit, mit uns zu bauen?
Wir sind auf der Suche nach leidenschaftlichen und talentierten Persönlichkeiten, die unsere Mission teilen, Menschen ein besseres Lebensgefühl zu verleihen.

Bei uns, einem etablierten Scale-up-Unternehmen auf einem disruptiven Markt, wird deine Leistung gesehen und belohnt.

Bist du eine agil denkende Person und möchtest dich unserer Mission anschließen?

Dann bewirb dich bei uns, werde ein Teil unseres hoch ambitionierten Teams und revolutioniere mit uns eine gesamte Industrie!

The Role's Purpose

Plexal operates at the intersection of government, industry and emerging technology, helping organisations turn innovation ambition into practical capability, adoption and measurable impact.
 
The Senior Lead, Government Innovation & Economic Growth will play a critical role in shaping and delivering Plexal's growth across government. This is a nationally focused role responsible for identifying, shaping and securing high-value opportunities across central government, public sector organisations and strategic partners.
 
Based in the North West, the role will help position Plexal at the forefront of the UK's evolving government and innovation landscape. As government influence, investment and decision-making become increasingly distributed beyond Whitehall, the role will help Plexal identify and capitalise on emerging opportunities across government, economic growth, public sector reform, innovation adoption and place-based investment.
 
The successful candidate will combine strong commercial leadership with deep government insight, helping Plexal understand where policy, funding and customer priorities are moving and translating those trends into strategic opportunities, partnerships and sustainable revenue growth.
 
This is a hands-on commercial leadership role combining business development, strategic relationship management, proposition development and opportunity leadership, while also acting as a senior advisor to the wider GTM and leadership teams.


What You'll Do

  • Government Growth & Opportunity Leadership
    • Identify, prioritise and lead the pursuit of high-value opportunities across UK government. 
    • Build and maintain senior relationships across government departments, agencies, arm's-length bodies and wider public sector organisations. 
    • Shape early-stage opportunities by aligning customer priorities, policy developments and commercial propositions. 
    • Lead complex multi-stakeholder pursuits from early engagement through to contract award. 
    • Navigate government procurement and commercial environments, ensuring Plexal is well positioned to maximise success. 
    • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of government priorities, funding mechanisms and investment strategies to identify future opportunities ahead of formal procurement.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategic Positioning
    • Develop deep insight into emerging government priorities including economic growth, innovation adoption, AI, cyber resilience, public sector reform, science and technology, and place-based investment. 
    • Translate policy, market and customer insight into actionable growth opportunities for Plexal. 
    • Help shape Plexal's understanding of where government priorities, investment and demand are evolving. 
    • Identify emerging markets, funding streams and policy-driven opportunities that align with Plexal's strategic objectives. 
    • Position Plexal as a trusted partner capable of helping government translate ambition into adoption and measurable impact.
  • Cross-Government Go-To-Market Leadership
    • Shape and co-own Plexal's cross-government go-to-market strategy. 
    • Identify priority growth areas, departments and opportunity themes aligned to Plexal's strengths. 
    • Support the development and refinement of propositions that respond to changing government needs. 
    • Build repeatable approaches to opportunity identification, qualification and pursuit. 
    • Strengthen commercial discipline and opportunity management across the organisation. 
    • Support the creation of scalable propositions that can be applied across multiple government customers and sectors.
  • Strategic Relationship Management & Ecosystem Development
    • Act as a senior external representative for Plexal across government, industry and innovation ecosystem engagements. 
    • Build trusted relationships with senior government leaders, policy makers, commercial stakeholders and delivery partners. 
    • Establish Plexal as a credible voice within conversations around innovation, technology adoption, economic growth and government transformation. 
    • Build relationships across emerging government and innovation ecosystems outside London as government investment and decision-making continues to evolve. 
    • Represent Plexal at senior meetings, industry forums, conferences and government-facing events.
  • Partnerships & Growth Enablement
    • Develop strategic relationships with consultancies, technology providers, universities, ecosystem partners and delivery organisations. 
    • Build and shape consortium opportunities where partner-led approaches strengthen Plexal's position. 
    • Support priority bids, negotiations and commercial pursuits across the wider organisation. 
    • Share best practice across government sales, account development and opportunity shaping. 
    • Mentor and support colleagues across the commercial and delivery teams to strengthen capability and confidence.
  • KPIs and Commercial Outcomes
    • Significant £m pipeline generated and influenced across government markets. 
    • Material revenue secured through direct and partner-led opportunities. 
    • Number and quality of strategic opportunities shaped prior to procurement. 
    • Growth in multi-year and repeatable revenue opportunities. 
    • Conversion rate improvement across priority pursuits. 
    • Growth in partner-led opportunities and consortium wins. 
    • Strength and depth of senior relationships across government and strategic partners.
    • Contribution to Plexal's long-term positioning across government innovation, adoption and economic growth markets.


Your Skills

  • Commercially driven, outcome-focused and highly proactive. 
  • Naturally curious about government priorities, policy developments and market trends. 
  • Highly credible operating at senior levels across government and industry. 
  • Strong relationship builder with the ability to influence and align diverse stakeholder groups. 
  • Strategic thinker capable of translating insight into action. 
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and shaping undefined opportunities. 
  • Collaborative and committed to enabling the success of others. 
  • Resilient, adaptable and able to thrive in fast-moving environments.


Your Experience

Essential:

  • Proven track record of selling into UK government and winning complex public sector opportunities. 
  • Demonstrable success securing and growing contracts valued at £1m+ and/or multi-year engagements. 
  • Strong understanding of government procurement, commercial processes and public sector buying environments. 
  • Experience building relationships with senior government stakeholders. 
  • Strong commercial acumen including opportunity shaping, negotiation and deal strategy. 
  • Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies in complex environments. 
  • Experience working with partners to shape and deliver consortium bids and strategic opportunities. 
  • Ability to operate effectively across strategy, relationship management and hands-on opportunity delivery. 
  • Strong understanding of the relationship between government policy, funding, investment priorities and commercial opportunity.
 
Highly desirable:
  • Experience working across multiple government departments or policy domains. 
  • Understanding of economic growth, devolution, place-based investment and public sector reform. 
  • Experience within innovation, technology, consulting, digital transformation, cyber or AI-related environments. 
  • Experience identifying and developing opportunities arising from policy change, government reform and market shifts. 
  • Existing network across UK government, strategic partners and innovation ecosystems. 
  • Experience operating within high-growth, entrepreneurial or scaling organisations. 
  • Familiarity with government priorities relating to AI adoption, cyber resilience, science and technology, productivity and economic growth.


Who You Are

  • Willingness to undertake regular national travel (>40%) and occasional international travel
  • Open to UK Nationals who hold or are eligible for Security Check (SC) clearance. (See more on clearance eligibility.)
  • Degree-level education or equivalent professional experience
  • Relevant commercial, consulting or public sector credentials are advantageous
  • Commitment to Plexal’s values of diversity, equity, and inclusion


Why us?

As a start-up, we thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment dedicated to empowering innovators. We embrace individuals who leverage technology and creativity to tackle our greatest challenges head-on. We strongly advocate for maintaining a harmonious work-life balance, our goal is to ensure every member of our team can authentically be themselves and live their best lives. We firmly believe that innovation and creativity flourish when we cultivate a diverse workforce, comprising highly skilled individuals with a wide range of perspectives to contribute.
 
In return we will offer you:

  • Salary: £80,000 - £100,000 depending on skills and experience
  • Annual bonus scheme
  • A generous pension scheme (with a company contribution of up to 10%)
  • Private healthcare, life assurance and critical illness cover
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Volunteering day
Plexal is an equal opportunities employer and we actively encourage applicants from individuals from all backgrounds. We are a Disability Committed employer and are willing to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

What is Jedox?

Jedox is a global leader in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) and a recognized Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, helping organizations transform fragmented planning into connected, data-driven decision-making.

Trusted by more than 2,500 customers worldwide, Jedox enables business planning, budgeting and forecasting for finance, sales, and broader enterprise departments with leading-edge technology to outperform digital transformation and provide tangible customer value. At the heart of the platform is JedoxAI - a multi-agent intelligence engine delivering explainable, AI-powered forecasting, natural-language insights and AIssisted™ planning - putting Jedox at the forefront of the shift to AI-driven performance management.


Your Responsibilities

As a Sales Account Executive (m/f/d) within the Jedox team, you will play a key part in helping enterprise customers to transform their planning, forecasting and performance management processes. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will use a value-based sales approach to show how Jedox provides modern, digital and integrated enterprise performance and analysis (xP&A) solutions.

In this role, you will own the entire sales process for enterprise customers, from identifying potential clients to closing deals. You will promote Jedox as the ideal solution for xP&A initiatives, work closely with internal teams and develop long-term relationships with customers and partners, while maintaining a strong focus on value, trust and sustainable success.

We are building a high-performing team defined by ownership, accountability and energy. This is a genuinely exciting time to join: AI is reshaping how every finance team plans and forecasts, and Jedox is right at the centre of that conversation - giving you a fresh, differentiated story to take to market. If you're a motivated seller who enjoys being out in front of customers and partners, and want to make your mark in an exciting company, you'll find real support, momentum and opportunity here. You will own your number, your territory and your pipeline - creating opportunity rather than waiting for it, with a team around you that celebrates the wins together.

  • Own the end-to-end sales cycle: Generate revenue by adopting a value-selling approach throughout the process, from initial engagement to closing enterprise-level deals - with full personal accountability for every outcome in your territory.
  • Create and own high-quality pipeline: Build and maintain healthy pipeline coverage against your quota through proactive, self-generated prospecting - not just inbound - with disciplined weekly pipeline management in our CRM as the single source of truth.
  • Communicate the value of Jedox: Demonstrate how Jedox and JedoxAI empower xP&A projects and elevate planning, forecasting and business decisions - bringing AI-driven, explainable forecasting into the conversation and anchoring every discussion on business outcomes, not features.
  • Inspire digital transformation: Engage prospects by presenting a clear and compelling vision of digitisation and integrated business planning.
  • Develop strategic sales plans: Identify, prospect and execute targeted sales plays and activities to win enterprise customers, including structured account planning, rigorous qualification (e.g. MEDDPICC) and multi-threading across finance, IT and operations stakeholders.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Acquire new customers by working closely with the pre-sales, channel management, marketing and business development teams - bringing colleagues and partners in early, and lifting each other up as one team with one number.
  • Drive market-facing activity: Contribute to workshops, webinars and events alongside marketing and partners to create demand and build visible expertise in your market.
  • Work smarter with AI: Actively use modern AI tools in your daily workflow - from account research and prospecting to preparing presentations, proposals and follow-ups - so more of your time goes where it counts: in front of customers and partners.
  • Own forecasting and pipeline management: Maintain accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts as well as pipeline reports, with strong CRM hygiene, and play an active role in prospecting activities.
  • Build lasting relationships: Build trusted partnerships with customers, partners and internal stakeholders to ensure long-term success.


Your Profile

  • Over three years' experience in professional sales, ideally within the FP&A function.
  • Experience in Enterprise Performance Management or in selling analytics, AI, data, or ERP solutions.
  • Strong record of success in achieving and exceeding sales goals.
  • Proven ability to build, manage and self-generate a healthy sales pipeline and expand existing accounts.
  • A high-ownership mindset: you act with urgency, take responsibility for your results, and when challenges arise you come with ideas on how to tackle them together.
  • Resilience and positivity: you're the kind of person who stays positive, keeps going and enjoys the journey as much as the win.
  • A love of being active in the market: you genuinely enjoy talking to customers and partners - on calls, in meetings and at events - and you know that's where great pipeline comes from.
  • Strong collaboration skills with a clear focus on customer success and innovation.
  • Confident, hands-on use of AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot or similar) in your day-to-day selling - for example researching accounts, building presentations and business cases, sharpening messaging and working smarter across the sales cycle.
  • Native or fluent English skills; an established network and knowledge of the UK & Ireland enterprise market are a real advantage.


Transparency Note: Use of Artificial Intelligence

As a tech-driven company, Jedox uses modern technologies — including AI — to continuously improve our processes.
In recruiting, AI may support us in screening and structuring applications. It does not replace human judgment, but helps us reduce bias and ensure a consistent candidate experience. Your application is always reviewed by real people.

Here you will find information about the data protection guidelines as well as the most recent security checks. This gives you complete clarity on how your data is protected and processed. The opportunity

Goodlord is on a mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, and we’re searching for an Enterprise Account Executive reporting directly to our Head of Sales to help us achieve it!

As we accelerate our strategic growth, you will step into a high-impact, pioneer role dedicated to our Enterprise segment (agents managing 1,500+ properties).

Joining an emerging enterprise function backed by dedicated ABM and SDR support, you will lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, position value to C-level executives, and help build and scale our Enterprise Go-To-Market playbook.

In this role you'll:

  • Build and execute strategic account plans for high-value enterprise accounts, partnering with dedicated ABM and SDR resources to drive multi-threaded C-suite outreach.

  • Lead rigorous discovery sessions using MEDDPICC to map complex organisational structures, diagnose operational risks, and present tailored ROI business cases.

  • Manage complex enterprise sales motions from initial engagement through legal, info-sec, procurement, and final sign-off for multi-year contracts.

  • Act as a core builder alongside early enterprise leadership to refine, standardise, and scale our Enterprise GTM playbook, templates, and collateral.

What we need from you:

  • Proven track record closing complex, multi-stakeholder B2B SaaS deals, typically £50k+ ARR and/or multi-year contracts, across longer Enterprise sales cycles (often 6–12 months).

  • Hands-on MEDDPICC experience to navigate complex deal cycles and maintain accurate CRM forecasting.

  • Experience multi-threading complex buying committees across C-suite, Operations, Finance, IT/Security, Legal and Procurement.

  • A demonstrable track record of value-led selling – moving customer conversations beyond features and price to build compelling commercial and ROI cases.

  • A builder mindset with comfort operating in scale-up environments where GTM processes are actively being co-created.

It would also be great if you have:

  • Experience selling SaaS into PropTech, Real Estate, Property Management, FinTech or another regulated/operationally complex environment.

  • An executive-level network across major UK letting agency groups, franchise networks, or corporate property managers.

  • Experience as an early hire in an emerging enterprise team, helping build sales collateral, objection-handling guides, and GTM strategy from scratch.

Why you'll love being a Goodlordian

Aside from the role, the people, our culture and our mission, we have some other things that make Goodlord a pretty awesome place to be. Here’s a few favourites amongst Goodlordians (check out our careers page for more info).

  • Grow with Goodlord: your development is important to us, that’s why we are Great Place to Work - certified. Have a goal in mind? Share it with us so we can use some of our annual development fund to support it. We guarantee you’ll learn loads and develop both personally and professionally!

  • Your well-being matters: bi-weekly coaching with Sanctus to provide Goodlordians with a safe place to talk and support your mental health

  • 25 days holiday (plus UK Bank holidays) plus 1 day per full holiday year up to 32 days: We believe regular breaks are essential for well-being and we encourage (some may say expect!) all Goodlordians to take full advantage of their annual leave entitlement.

  • Supporting your family: we offer Goodlordians of all genders a generous 3 months of fully-paid time off to look after their new arrivals

  • Our team: we’re an energetic, sociable, and talented bunch who are super passionate about what we do and determined to make a difference. We’re all in it together, we learn from each other, we’re genuine and we don’t have time for politics

What’s next?

If you’re ready to help us on our mission to be the gold standard platform for renting, then click apply (2-3 minutes)!

A full job spec is available on request.

Goodlord wants applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life; we are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment.

Creating a space where everyone feels included is central to who we are. Bookkeeper — Lab54

Location: London. All 3 days in office for the first three months. From month 4, 1 day per week remote once the agreed targets are being met.

Shape: Part-time, 3 days per week. Permanent or contract — both considered.

Salary: £30–34k FTE equivalent, pro-rata (£18–20.5k at 3 days). Contract equivalent £150–200 per day.

Reports to: Financial Controller (interim: Managing Director)

Start: As soon as available

About Lab54

Lab54 is a content-led events and production company: [Anywhere But A Club.]

We create high-impact experiences in unexpected locations, capture them, and turn them into content. Combined global audience of 425,000+. We work with brands, record labels and artists — around 100 events a year across brand activations, artist pop-ups, hard-ticket shows, house parties and festival takeovers.

The role

The Bookkeeper is Lab54's day-to-day finance function: reconciliation, purchase-order matching, receipt capture, invoicing, debtor chasing and payroll preparation.

The defining feature of the job is that every pound has to land against an event. Lab54's core financial object isn't the month — it's the project. Each event carries a code (YYMM-Owner-Event-City) that runs from HubSpot through Xero, Teamwork and the purchase-order flow. Coding transactions to that project is not admin; it's the thing that makes per-event profitability computable. It is the single most important part of this role.

This role prepares, never approves. All payment runs are approved by the Managing Director, with the CEO approving above an agreed threshold.

Responsibilities

Purchase orders and supplier ledger

  • Match supplier invoices to their purchase order in Xero. This is a manual link, and it is the control that stops us paying more than we agreed.
  • Enforce the PO rule at the front door: any commitment of £500 or more needs a PO, and an invoice arriving without a PO number goes back to the supplier rather than into the ledger.
  • Prepare payment runs for approval. Nothing leaves the business without a bill, a PO and a sign-off.
  • Reconcile supplier statements monthly against our purchase ledger — the check that catches duplicate invoices and payments before they're made.
  • Maintain the purchase ledger and keep the aged creditor position accurate.

Reconciliation and coding

  • Bank and card reconciliations kept current within 48 hours, including Revolut Business card spend against Xero tracking categories.
  • Every reconciled line matched to a real source document. A line that reconciles without a bill behind it is an exception to raise, not a box to tick.
  • Code every transaction to the correct project code and tracking category. Chase the team when a code is missing rather than guessing one.
  • Keep the suspense and uncoded accounts at nil by month-end.
  • Produce a weekly untagged-spend report, by spender, and drive it to zero.

Receipts and VAT recovery

  • Chase and capture missing receipts to a 98% target. This is a cash exercise, not a filing one — every missing VAT invoice is input VAT we can't reclaim.
  • Flag transactions carrying no VAT treatment where the supplier is UK VAT-registered.
  • Prepare the VAT return workings for the external accountancy firm, who own submission.

Sales invoicing and debtors

  • Raise client invoices within 48 hours of the billing trigger, coded to the project.
  • Own debtor chasing end to end — a consistent cycle, escalated when it stalls, so nobody else in the business is carrying it.
  • Match incoming receipts to the right invoice and contact. Money that arrives against the wrong customer looks identical to money that never arrived.
  • Keep sales invoice sequencing clean — anything voided or reissued carries a recorded reason.

Project close

  • When a project closes, produce its final position: budgeted cost against actual cost, budgeted revenue against invoiced revenue, and the resulting margin.
  • Issue that to the CEO and Operations Director as a matter of routine. It is not a report anyone should have to request.
  • Late costs land after an event has finished — that's the nature of the business. The job is to make sure they land against the right project and that the closing number reflects them.

Cash and reporting

  • Produce a weekly cash one-pager: bank position, overdue debtors with days outstanding, payment runs due, projected balance.
  • Keep the company's master P&L model current — updating actuals and committed costs as they change, so the forecast reflects where the business genuinely is.
  • The model is ours; you update the numbers within it. Structural or formula changes come to the CEO first.

Payroll preparation

  • Prepare payroll data and submit it to the external payroll provider ahead of deadline.
  • Post the payroll journal to Xero each month. Wages must not sit in a control account.
  • Confirm the payroll account is funded before each run. This role does not execute payroll.

Close, deadlines and records

  • Run the monthly close to a published working-day deadline: accruals prepared with supporting detail, journals posted, period locked.
  • Every accrual carries a schedule — supplier, event, date of work. No balance we can't explain.
  • Maintain the statutory deadline register (VAT, PAYE, corporation tax, Companies House) and flag each one in advance. No filing sits invisibly in someone else's workflow.
  • Keep records orderly and audit-ready for the external accountancy firm.

What the first 90 days actually look like

We are being straight about this because we want someone who finds it interesting rather than alarming.

Lab54 has grown faster than its finance function, and we've recently changed accountants. The ledger carries a real backlog: untagged transactions across two financial years, unposted payroll journals, a month-end close that has not been run to a cadence, and a purchase-order process that has only just gone live. There is a documented correction schedule and an external FD working through it.

The first 90 days is a clean-up, not a steady state.

Days 1–30. Learn the ledger and the project-code structure. Take over reconciliation, receipt capture and PO matching. Get the weekly untagged report running.

Days 31–60. Clear the untagged backlog. Take over sales invoicing, debtor chasing and received-payment matching. Payroll preparation and the monthly payroll journal move across.

Days 61–90. Run a full month close to deadline: suspense at nil, every accrual scheduled, supplier statements reconciled. Per-project cost data becomes reportable for the first time.

After that it becomes a genuinely well-defined job inside a documented control structure — and you'll have built it.

On being in the office. The first three months are fully office-based, and that's deliberate rather than a policy position. Clearing a backlog this size means asking people questions in real time — whose card that was, what the missing PO covers, which event a supplier belongs to. That's an hour of work in a room and a week of work over email. From month 4, one of the three days moves to remote, provided the measures below are being met.

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Proven bookkeeping experience. Xero to a high standard is non-negotiable — tracking categories, purchase orders, bank rules, manual journals.
  • Purchase-order matching and supplier statement reconciliation as routine practice.
  • A project- or job-costing background — agency, events, production, construction, consultancy, anywhere the job rather than the month is the unit of profit. This is the part of the role we can't train quickly.
  • Strong reconciliation, coding and purchase-ledger discipline.
  • Experience preparing payroll data for an external provider and posting the payroll journal.
  • Comfortable working inside a defined control structure where you prepare and someone else approves.
  • Reliability over ambition. The value of this role is that nothing is ever late or missing.

Nice to have

  • Multi-currency invoicing and foreign supplier payments. We run events across Europe.
  • Dext, Revolut Business, or similar capture and expense tooling.
  • Experience cleaning up a ledger rather than only maintaining a tidy one.

How you'll work

  • Meticulous. Proactive on receipts, POs and debtors — chasing people is part of the job, not an escalation.
  • Willing to say when something doesn't look right. A number you can't explain is a question, not a rounding difference.
  • Discreet and trustworthy with company finances.

We're Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world's healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don't choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.

The role

Heidi's UK and Europe business is growing faster than the finance scaffolding underneath it. Central finance across Sydney, Melbourne and Manila runs month-end close, core accounting and day-to-day operations, but the region needs someone on the ground who owns the accuracy of its numbers and sits close enough to the commercial team to shape decisions before they get made. Today, regional leaders wait on Australian hours for answers about their own P&L. You'll end that.

The role has two halves and both carry equal weight. You'll own regional financial control and compliance: the integrity of the balance sheet, the accuracy of management reporting and forecasts, cash, strong local controls, and statutory obligations across Companies House, HMRC and VAT, directed through external advisers. You'll also be a hands-on business partner to UK and Europe leadership, Sales and Customer Success, owning the P&L narrative, bringing a commercial view to pricing, deal terms and customer economics, and making sure teams see the financial consequence of the choices they make. You'll report to the Group Financial Controller with a dotted line to FP&A.

What you'll do

Financial reporting and month-end close

  • Own the integrity of the UK&Europe balance sheet, with reconciliations that stay current, reviewed and explainable

  • Own the accuracy of the UK&Europe monthly group reporting and management accounts with variance commentary that explains movements

  • Be the single point of contact for group finance on anything UK&Europe: queries, adjustments, restatements, consolidation-level questions

Compliance and risk oversight

  • Own the UK&Europe compliance calendar (Companies House, HMRC, VAT) by directing external accountants and advisers

  • Own the adviser relationships (accounting, tax, audit), keeping work well scoped, reviewed and connected back to Heidi's internal finance standards

  • Build an early-warning process so compliance risk is caught and escalated well before it threatens trading status

  • Be the accountable owner if something in the compliance chain breaks down

Commercial business partnering

  • Be the day-to-day finance partner to UK&Europe leadership, owning the regional P&L narrative, budget vs actual and the "why" behind the numbers

  • Bring a commercial lens to pricing, deal terms and customer economics, flagging risk and opportunity early

  • Translate regional performance into clear, decision-ready input for FP&A and company leadership

  • Give UK&Europe business leaders a reliable, self-serve view of their numbers, so decisions stop waiting on Australian hours

  • Feed central finance the regional inputs it needs at close: accrual estimates, revenue and spend context, then review and sign off on the UK&Europe result

Revenue risk and collections

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to resolve aged and disputed balances and unblock stuck revenue

  • Own the commercial view of collection risk: which accounts, why, and what it means for cash, and feed it into forecasting

  • Drive down UK&Europe DSO by fixing the upstream causes (contracting, disputes, process), not by chasing invoices

FinOps, controls and performance frameworks

  • Build the operating rhythm that turns UK&Europe finance from reactive support into a reliable performance framework: clear KPIs, owners, review cadences and escalation paths

  • Partner with budget owners on spend decisions before they are made, rather than policing them after the fact

  • Strengthen financial controls across spend, approvals, vendor onboarding, card usage, subscriptions and commercial commitments, while keeping the process pragmatic for a fast-moving region

  • Review regional AP and card activity, including prompt removal of leaver access and cards, and escalate anomalies to central finance operations

  • Partner with external accountants, tax advisers, compliance providers and other vendors, making sure work is well-scoped, reviewed and connected back to Heidi’s internal finance standards

  • Use FinOps-style discipline to connect spend, usage and outcomes, especially across tooling, GTM systems, implementation costs and region-specific operating expenses

  • Create simple documentation and control checks so the region can scale without relying on informal knowledge or one-off fixes

What you'll need

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen — comfortable moving between P&L narrative, deal economics and cash impact

  • Experience business partnering with Sales, Customer Success or regional leadership in a growth business

  • Track record improving collections or DSO by fixing root causes, not just process

  • Experience owning spend or expense controls in a way that supports the business rather than only governing it

  • Comfortable directing (not necessarily performing) statutory compliance and VAT work through external advisers

  • High degree of autonomy and ownership in a small, remote-first global finance team

  • Clear, confident communicator — able to hold your own with commercial leaders and external advisers alike

  • Experience in a multi-entity or multi-currency business

Nice to have

  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company

  • Qualified accountant (ACA / ACCA / CIMA or equivalent)

  • Exposure to Companies House, HMRC and Irish Revenue processes

  • Experience with Campfire, Airwallex or similar modern finance tooling

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You'll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we'd like to see. We're medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who've felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we're building isn't always easy. But we didn't choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn't whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you're doing the defining work of your career.

We take care of you.

We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

You report to the VP of Revenue Operations, lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

  • Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

  • Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

  • Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

  • Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

  • Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

  • Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

  • Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

  • Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

  • Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

  • Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

  • Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

  • Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

  • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

  • Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

  • Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

  • Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

  • Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

  • Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

Experience

  • Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

  • Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Accountant / Financial Reporting specialist to join our Finance Team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help strengthen core accounting execution, audit management, and monthly consolidated results analysis while being part of a high-growth environment as we scale our financial infrastructure. If you're excited about leveraging AI and automation to redefine modern accounting with a strong focus on IFRS excellence and financial rigor, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Accounting Associate Director and work closely with teams across the Finance organisation. You will be part of a team dedicated to technical rigor and operational efficiency, partnering with cross-functional departments to elevate our accounting processes to the next level.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Accountant, you will:

  • Prepare and post journal entries, perform balance sheet reconciliations, and drive high standards for period close improving quality and speed.

  • Own the preparation of audit schedules, coordinate responses to requests, and drive the closure of audit questions to ensure a predictable, well-documented process.

  • Deep dive into monthly results, flagging risks, unusual transactions, and key movements while providing decision-ready insights for finance leadership.

  • Identify accounting risks, implement practical mitigations, and strengthen internal controls to ensure our processes are scalable and accurate.

  • Actively leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and consistency, identifying opportunities to standardise and simplify recurring accounting work.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 6+ years of experience with a strong ability to apply IFRS in real-world scenarios.

  • Comfort working with consolidated results, analysing variances, and exercising complex accounting estimates and judgments.

  • Proven experience managing audits end-to-end or acting as the primary finance contact for external auditors.

  • A track record (or clear potential) of using AI and automation to improve accounting outcomes and efficiency.

  • The ability to operate effectively in a fast-changing environment with an "ownership mindset" and excellent judgment.

  • Strong ability to translate complex accounting issues into scalable process improvements and clear insights for stakeholders.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You want genuine agency at group level rather than executing instructions handed down by a central team

  • You'd rather design a process than inherit one, and you want to see your own work implemented

  • You like variety. This is a different topic most days, not a fixed monthly cycle

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You want a settled, mature environment where the process is set and the day looks the same. That's the clearest reason this role doesn't work out for people

  • You need stable priorities. It's volatile here. Several topics run at once, progress depends on other people, and priorities can change overnight

  • You want to stay inside accounting. A large part of the job is working with teams outside Finance and with external advisors in each country

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 - 12 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the Audit Readiness initiative to drive impact in our year-end execution and documentation standards.

  • Collaborate with the Finance team to embed AI-forward ways of working, automating manual workflows to increase team capacity.

  • Grow your skills in process improvements and financial analysis, taking on new challenges as the company continues to scale across our legal entity markets.

  • We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger leadership projects, mastering the intersection of AI and Finance, or deepening your expertise in complex consolidated reporting.

The location

This role is hybrid (on average, 3 days a week in the office) and can be located in either our Lisbon or Madrid office.

Show me the benefits!

💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  • Hiring manager interview: A conversation with our Accounting Associate Director covering your technical accounting and IFRS experience.

  • Team panel and Pleo challenge: You'll meet the hiring manager, his manager and a peer from the team. The challenge is presented live in the session, so there's nothing to prepare or send in advance. We're looking at how you handle complexity, new areas and stakeholders.

  • Final interview: A closing conversation, used where it's helpful for both sides.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired this role, we received a lot of applications but can only interview a finite number of people. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

  • Pleo challenge: A 60-minute chat with peers and/or stakeholders to check how you would think and act in the role. Expect some real life examples as well as on the spot challenges

  • Final Interview: A 30-minute final chat with one of our senior stakeholders

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we're looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a significant number of applications but only a fraction were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn't make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Security sits within Infrastructure and Engineering, protecting the distributed, real-time systems behind our trading engine. The team's remit spans our core products and our DCM/DCO entities, with a real regulatory dimension to the work, particularly around our CFTC-regulated business units. Alongside that regulatory scope, the focus is squarely on hands-on engineering: designing, building, and shipping the security tooling and controls that let engineering teams move fast safely.

This is a founding build. You'll stand up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and mature it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams to build the controls, automation, and guardrails our trading systems and regulated entities need.

What you will do:

  • Build the Foundations: Be part of a founding build, standing up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and maturing it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams.

  • Automate as Code: Automate security processes as code, embedding compliance and infrastructure-as-code checks into CI/CD pipelines without slowing down frequent shipping.

  • Assess & Remediate: Conduct risk audits and assessments, translating findings into practical recommendations for engineering teams, and be hands-on in implementing those recommendations.

  • Regulatory Familiarity: Familiarity with CFTC system safeguards expectations, including 17 C.F.R. § 38.1051 and § 39.18 or similar regulatory requirements.

  • CI/CD & Tooling: Proficiency with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, CircleCI) and security tools (Snyk, Aqua, Trivy, Checkov, Twistlock, Clair).

Mission

Airspeed is changing how revenue teams work. Our AI Revenue Orchestration Platform doesn't just analyze conversations — it acts on them. By turning every customer interaction into insight and action, Airspeed Agents help teams close gaps, move faster, and focus on what matters most: selling.

With 100+ SaaS customers and 90%+ adoption among reps, Airspeed is setting a new standard for execution at scale.

The Role

We're hiring a Finance & Operations Lead to build the financial and operational foundations that will support Airspeed's next stage of growth. You'll own our finance engine, company reporting, and core operating systems — helping make Airspeed easier to run and its decisions better.

This is a senior, hands-on role built for a high-performance operator who can move from financial modeling and board reporting to improving workflows and building scalable systems.

You'll report directly to the CEO and work closely with both founders and every functional leader.

This is not a conventional Chief of Staff, strategy-only, or back-office finance role. It's a builder-operator role for someone who takes full ownership of results and uses AI and automation to remove manual work wherever possible.

 

What You'll Own

 

Finance and Reporting:

  • Own the budget, rolling forecast, cash, runway, and scenario planning — giving leadership a clear, trusted view of the company's financial position and future needs.

  • Run a fast and accurate monthly close with our external accounting partners, and produce clear management and board reporting that explains what happened, why it happened, and what requires a decision.

  • Build a trusted view of ARR, bookings, retention, gross margin, burn, headcount, and unit economics, with clear definitions and reconciled data sources.

  • Oversee billing, collections, payroll coordination, expenses, procurement, and vendors, while putting practical controls in place to keep Airspeed ready for fundraising, audit, tax, and diligence.

     

AI, Automation, and Systems:

  • Make Airspeed AI-native in how we operate, not only in what we sell — redesigning recurring workflows with AI agents, automation tools, APIs, and lightweight code.

  • Build dependable operating systems with clean data, exception handling, audit trails, and human approval where needed, and create self-serve workflows that don't depend on you becoming the human router for every request.

  • Measure the impact of automation through speed, accuracy, reporting latency, and manual hours removed, while helping teams use AI safely with sensitive data and high-stakes decisions.

Company Operations:

  • Own the company operating cadence, including planning, KPI reviews, and decision follow-through, ensuring teams have clarity on priorities, ownership, and next steps.

  • Build scalable workflows for purchasing, contracts, onboarding, offboarding, access, and policies, and improve processes that cross team boundaries while keeping ownership clear.

  • Hold external partners and vendors accountable for scope, service, cost, and quality. Step into important gaps when needed, then fix the underlying system so they don't continue to depend on you.

 

What Success Looks Like

  • Leadership and the board trust the numbers and the forward forecast.

  • Close, reporting, forecasting, and planning run on a clear schedule with minimal manual chasing.

  • Core SaaS metrics have clear definitions and reconciled sources.

  • High-volume workflows are automated, monitored, and documented.

  • Airspeed can continue to grow without finance and operations headcount increasing with every layer of complexity.

 

Qualifications

  • Experience in finance, business operations, or a combined role at a scaling B2B SaaS or technology company.

  • Hands-on ownership of planning, forecasting, management reporting, cash, runway, and board materials.

  • A track record of building operating systems, not simply administering existing processes.

  • Strong data and spreadsheet skills, with the ability to connect information across systems and identify when the underlying data can't be trusted.

  • An AI-native working style, with experience using AI to analyze, draft, reconcile, monitor, automate, and execute work.

  • Sound commercial judgment and exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues simply and challenge senior stakeholders when needed.

  • A bias for action: a high-ownership, low-ego operator who is comfortable moving between company-level questions and detailed execution.

  • Comfort working closely across Finance, Sales, Product, Engineering, and other functional teams in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in scale-up finance, finance transformation, consulting, or accounting followed by hands-on operating experience.

  • A professional accounting qualification.

  • Experience working with UK and US entities, subscription revenue, fundraising, or finance automation.

  • Experience at an early-stage startup or another lean, high-growth environment.

  • A passion for AI-native products, agent-driven workflows, and building smarter ways of working.

What We Value

  • Customer obsession and a relentless focus on measurable impact.

  • Team players who raise the bar and help scale processes and best practices.

  • Creative problem-solvers who can turn imperfect information into clear plans and results.

  • Operators who step into important gaps, solve the immediate problem, and then build systems that prevent it from recurring.

Why Join

  • Shape how the whole company operates.

  • Build an AI-native finance and operations function from the ground up.

  • Work directly with the founders and influence major company decisions.

  • Join an international SaaS company at a point where strong foundations can create outsized value.

Benefits & Perks

  • Market-competitive total compensation package with equity (stock options).

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Collaborative, inclusive culture that values growth, learning, and excellence.

How to Apply

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile. Include a short note about one finance or operations workflow you redesigned or automated, what changed, and the measurable impact.

Airspeed is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and support candidates from all backgrounds and experiences. If you're excited to own outcomes, influence how an international AI company operates, and help scale a category-defining platform, we'd love to hear from you.

London - Hybrid-Working: 3 days in office, 2 days from home

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Are you passionate about using data, technology, and payments expertise to drive tangible customer value?

We’re looking for an experienced and commercially minded Head of Product to lead the evolution of our optimisation and orchestration products, scaling them to the next level.

You’ll operate at the intersection of Product, Data Science, and Commercial teams, translating analytical insights into measurable business outcomes for our customers and for APEXX. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys connecting complex technical capabilities with commercial value, inspiring cross-functional alignment, and ensuring optimisation becomes a core growth driver for the company.

If you thrive on solving complex payment challenges, shaping intelligent optimisation products, and communicating value with clarity and conviction, we’d love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

Product Strategy & Commercial Ownership

  • Define and drive the long-term strategy and roadmap for APEXX’s Optimisation and Orchestration suite, ensuring clear differentiation and customer value.

  • Establish the commercial framework for optimisation, working with Finance, Sales, and Marketing to design value-based pricing models.

  • Lead the evolution of optimisation from a capability into a scalable product line, influencing its positioning, packaging, and monetisation.

  • Provide thought leadership across the organisation on the role of AI and data-driven optimisation in payments.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Delivery

  • Partner with Engineering and Data Science to develop AI/ML-powered optimisation features that improve authorisation, reduce cost, and drive measurable performance gains.

  • Work closely with Sales, Relationship Management, and Marketing teams to articulate product value and support commercial success across the portfolio.

  • Drive alignment across teams, ensuring strategic intent translates into customer-ready, high-impact product delivery.

Customer Value, Growth & Commercial Enablement

  • Translate model performance and analytical insights into ROI-focused, commercially compelling narratives for customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Enable Sales and Relationship Managers to position and sell optimisation as a premium, value-generating product.

  • Be the Subject matter expert on Interchange and Scheme fee pricing and optimisation opportunities.

  • Partner with customers to identify where data, AI, and automation can unlock incremental efficiency, acceptance rates, or cost reduction.

  • Contribute directly to upsell and cross-sell opportunities, helping turn product performance into revenue growth.

Product Excellence & Evidence Driven Decision Making

  • Define success metrics, experimentation frameworks, and governance around optimisation performance.

  • Promote strong product management discipline - discovery, validation, delivery, and measurement — across optimisation workstreams.

  • Use data and evidence to balance strategic ambition with operational focus, ensuring decisions are measurable and outcomes are sustainable.

ABOUT YOU:

  • You've done this before: You have demonstrable experience in Product Management, with a proven record of leading and scaling complex, data-driven products with clear commercial outcomes.

  • You're commercially driven: Commercially astute, able to craft value propositions and communicate financial impact confidently to senior and external audiences.

  • You're an influencer: Natural influencer who can inspire cross-functional teams and align stakeholders around a common product vision.

  • You think big picture: Strategic yet hands-on, capable of operating at both portfolio and execution level in a fast-moving environment.

GREAT TO HAVE:

  • You have domain knowledge: You have Deep understanding of payment transaction lifecycle, including authorisation, authentication (3DS), settlement, fraud, chargebacks, interchange and scheme fees.

WHY JOIN US:

You’ll help shape the future of payments optimisation at APEXX building products that directly impact merchant performance and profitability. You’ll work with talented teams across product, data, and engineering, driving measurable improvements in one of the most dynamic spaces in FinTech.

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the strategic direction of optimisation products and influence product management practices across the team.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:
Great people deserve great rewards. We believe in recognising the impact you make with competitive compensation and benefits that support you both at work and beyond.

Whether it's taking time to recharge, looking after your health, working from somewhere new, or investing in your growth, we've built a benefits package designed to help you thrive, because when our people do well, so does APEXX.

💰 Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries that recognise your skills, experience, and the impact you make.

🏖️ Generous Time Off :Take the time you need to rest and recharge with annual leave, public holidays, and wellbeing-focused time away from work.25 days holiday plus bank holidays. We love birthdays! - additional paid holiday for your birthday (26 days). Holiday increases a day each year after 3 years and have the option to carry 5 days holiday over to the following year.

Trusted by leading global brands including Ryanair, TUI, Hotelbeds, CarTrawler, Avon, and Jet2, we're redefining enterprise payments by making them smarter, faster, and more reliable.

As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities to make an impact. Whether you're building products, solving complex engineering challenges, or supporting the teams behind them, you'll play a meaningful role in shaping the future of global payments at APEXX.

Working collaboratively across disciplines, you’ll contribute to impactful features and continuously improve quality, reliability, and usability across our internal platforms.
